concern_summary: This concern encompasses functionalities related to managing and retrieving reports that are currently on hold, focusing on filtering actions and transactions linked to reports with a specific hold status.
This concern focuses on managing and updating report options, including settings, accessibility, and filtering recent reports based on user preferences and configurations.
Retrieval and processing of report data, focusing on actions, statuses, and transaction details to enhance user interaction with report information.
This concern involves the selection and display of report field options, facilitating user interaction through filtering, sorting, and managing the settings and details of specific report fields.
This concern focuses on the report preview functionality, which involves updating the report preview by generating relevant messages and managing associated transactions.
This concern encapsulates the functionality related to retrieving and navigating to the current report's details, specifically focusing on video attachments associated with the report.

This concern encompasses the management of the Left Hand Navigation (LHN) component, including the rendering and interaction of navigation options, user interactions, visibility toggling, organization of reports into groups, and the adjustment of routing based on navigation state.
